title: Account Director
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As an Account Director at Via, you will be the face and voice of Via for our partners, both internally and externally. You'll build genuine, durable relationships with the cities and operators working to deliver better transportation for their communities, while owning the commercial outcomes that come with it — from complex renewals to service expansions. Our Partner Success team is made up of talented, collaborative people who are passionate about making public transit better, and at Via, the work we do together translates into real impact for the people who depend on it every day.

About the Role:

  • Own a portfolio of complex, high-value partner relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for executive city and agency leadership and setting the standard for how we show up at that level
  • Act as a trusted advisor and consultant to partners at the most senior levels, translating their ideas and community needs into revenue opportunities and driving decisions that shape service outcomes
  • Build and steward deep, long-term relationships with partners, acting as a strategic peer to senior leadership and spotting opportunities for service growth and revenue generation
  • Use service performance data to set the strategic direction for each partnership, ensuring decisions on quality, efficiency, and growth are grounded in evidence
  • Independently lead multi-year and highly complex contract renewals and service expansions, navigating high-stakes negotiations with executive stakeholders to increase year-on-year revenue
  • Champion new products and capabilities internally, influencing Via's roadmap and advocating for partners to facilitate the expansion of each partner's service size and scope

About You:

  • 10+ years of relevant work experience in a client-facing role, with a track record of owning and growing strategic accounts independently at the most senior levels
  • Fluency in French and English is required for frequent client interaction.
  • Quantitatively inclined and data savvy; you use complex data sets to drive strategic decisions and influence senior stakeholders both internally and externally
  • An entrepreneurial relationship builder who brings clarity and confidence to highly complex, politically sensitive situations, turning them into opportunities to deepen trust
  • A reliable, motivated self-starter who shapes the way things are done and sets a standard others aspire to
  • A natural leader in every sense — someone whose judgment, presence, and way of operating raises the quality of the work and the people around them, regardless of title

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
  • Salary Range: $160,000-$200,000 CAD
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% company-paid premiums starting on your first day of work.
  • A Group RRSP & DPSP with a company match.
  • Standard and extended job-protected parental leave options, with company-paid health benefits fully maintained during your leave
  • Additional wellness benefits (including 24/7 virtual medicine, mental health practitioner coverage, EAP, and other wellness perks)
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually, plus paid provincial statutory holidays

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Account Director, Central US (Remote)
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As Director of Partner Success, you’ll be the face and voice of Via for our partners both internally and externally. In this dynamic role, you’ll build genuine and durable customer relationships while converting those relationships into opportunities for long-term revenue growth. You will serve as our partners’ trusted advisor by providing strategic guidance on operational, go-to-market, and product-related issues. Simultaneously, you will be an internal advocate for partners with Via by championing for new products and capabilities to facilitate the expansion of each partner’s service size and scope. This is a quota carrying role.

This is a remote-first role based in the US Central region. We're ideally looking for candidates in Chicago or the broader Midwest, but are open to other locations including Texas.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop a vision and strategy for partners by assessing their strengths and weaknesses to assist them in setting and achieving ambitious goals
  • Build deep and trusting long-term relationships with partners by identifying partner pain points, providing solutions, and recognizing opportunities for service growth and revenue generation
  • Analyze daily, weekly, and long-term service performance data to provide partners with actionable recommendations that improve their services’ quality, efficiency, and growth
  • Negotiate and sign contract renewals and service expansions to increase year-on-year revenue from each partnership
  • Strategically navigate your market’s unique landscape using research strong analytical skills to build compelling, data-driven business cases for our platform and demonstrate our value proposition across a range of verticals.
  • Be a thought partner to clients by educating and consulting with them to develop regional transit plans and find funding mechanisms within your market.

Who You Are:

  • You have 10+ years of client facing experience with a record of achievement in the Sales, Business Development, Consulting, or similar space with preference for candidates who have worked with the public sector.
  • Relationship builder who remains calm and collected when facing crisis or criticism and celebrates partners’ successes with them
  • Intuitive communicator; whether in customer conversations, product presentations, or written proposals, you always strike the right tone and communicate persuasively.
  • Quantitatively-inclined and data savvy; you may not be a Tableau expert, but you enjoy drawing quick, insightful conclusions from complex data sets, asking critical questions, and synthesizing raw numbers into simple, actionable recommendations
  • Superb commercial intuition and exceptional judgment -- you know when to push and when to yield in maximizing the value of a potential deal.
  • A reliable, motivated self-starter with a passionate growth mentality. You enjoy fast-paced environments, aren’t deterred by setbacks or pivots, and thrive in roles requiring a very high degree of responsibility.
  • An excellent team player; you’re a meaningful individual contributor, and a mentor to others on your team. You view successes as team efforts, and enjoy working with others.
  • Expertise in renewals, up-selling, and developing relationships with senior level officials and executives
  • Must be willing to travel 25-50% as needed

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary range: $160,000-$210,000, determined by experience, knowledge, and skills. Total compensation also includes variable pay and equity.
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.
  • A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting.
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.
  • Additional benefits (family planning, mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

We’re Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.

Our teams of world-class engineers, data-scientists, product managers, operations specialists, marketers, transit experts and more bring cutting-edge AI-powered software and innovative technology-enabled operations to our partners across the globe. Founded in 2012, Via builds solutions to digitize, automate, and enable data-driven decision making for entire transportation networks; fixed-route buses, microtransit, paratransit, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and more.

If you’re excited to be at the forefront of modernizing the future of transportation, are up for solving tough problems, and willing to become/already are a transit nerd, we are the place for you. Even if your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Administrative Specialist
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As an Administrative Specialist at Via, you will serve as the central hub connecting transit technology, drivers, and riders across Fixed Route, Paratransit, and Microtransit operations. This role delivers high-quality customer assistance, manages real-time dispatch and trip scheduling, processes rider eligibility applications, and maintains accurate administrative, fare, and operational records.

This role will be in-person 5 days a week

What You’ll Do:

  • Customer Care and Administration:
    • Serve as the primary, welcoming point of contact for walk-in visitors and callers, assisting with route and schedule planning, issuing employee/passenger ID badges, selling passes, and managing daily cash register transactions, reconciliations, and group billing.
    • Oversee driver sign-in/sign-out processes, audit post-trip manifests, reconcile collected fares, and accurately log daily mileage and trip data into core operating systems.
  • Process Paratransit Eligibility:
    • Receive, review, and process ADA Paratransit and Mobility eligibility applications, verify documentation, update rider accessibility profiles, and track eligibility expiration dates.
  • Schedule, Dispatch, & Monitor Live Service:
    • Create manifests for Paratransit and Microtransit services, and adjust schedules as needed to manage daily operations.
    • Maintain radio communication with drivers, direct and monitor bus activity across the system, provide real-time updates on passenger pick-ups/drop-offs, and triage live operational issues to ensure safe, reliable, and on-time service.

Who You Are:

  • Thrive in fast-paced environments: able to make sound decisions on the fly, oversee multiple tasks simultaneously, and prioritize effectively
  • Tech savvy, able to learn new software and adapt to changes
  • An empathetic and effective communicator who finds the right tone in any context and genuinely enjoys supporting people in person or over the phone.
  • Calm under pressure and able to think on your feet
  • Willingness to learn and a commitment to great service
  • Proactive, Observant, and keen to improve: if something’s not working, you come up with a better way while being able to anticipate and prevent problems before they start
  • An exceptional team player: people love working with you, and you can quickly contribute to cross-functional teams
  • Ownership mentality: take full responsibility for delivering great service to customers
  • Flexible and adaptable across different shifts

What We Offer

  • Salary Range: $20.48/HR, with routine increases
  • Benefits options available for Full-Time employees

As an Algorithm Researcher at Via, you’ll join our R&D team in London as part of the core Algo group, which is responsible for developing and maintaining Via’s proprietary algorithms that run in production on our live servers. The role sits at the intersection of algorithm development, data science, and software engineering. You’ll work on complex algorithmic problems, explore and evaluate different approaches, and turn your solutions into reliable production systems that support Via’s transportation networks around the world. If you enjoy combining analytical thinking, algorithms, data, and hands-on development, this position might be just for you!

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop, and improve Via’s core algorithms and business logic, solving complex real-world problems.
  • Explore and evaluate algorithmic approaches using data, experimentation, and analytical methods.
  • Develop and maintain mission-critical services that bring algorithmic solutions into production.
  • Work with large datasets to analyze system behavior and improve the performance of our algorithms.
  • Take ownership of complex technical problems, from initial research and exploration through to production.
  • Work in close collaboration with algorithm developers, researchers, data scientists, and software engineers.

Who You Are:

  • M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science / Mathematics / Statistics / Operations Research / similar quantitative field.
  • 3+ years of relevant industry experience in algorithm development, data science, research, or software engineering with a strong algorithmic focus.
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and analytical problem-solving.
  • Strong Python skills and experience developing production-quality code.
  • Experience working with data and applying data science, optimization, or analytical techniques to solve complex problems.
  • Experience taking algorithms, models, or prototypes and turning them into production systems.
  • Experience with DevOps and cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, etc.) — strong advantage.
  • Experience in architecture and maintaining cloud systems — strong advantage.
  • Curious and analytical: you enjoy exploring different approaches and understanding the data behind your solutions.
  • Pragmatic: you can break complex problems into smaller problems and find simple, effective solutions.
  • Hands-on: you enjoy taking ideas from research or experimentation all the way into production.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Becoming part of a company that was awarded for its commitment to social good:
    • We are one of 17 Ventures That Embody the U.N.’s 17 Sustainable Development Goals
    • Inc. Magazine’s “Best in Business” Awardee in the software category for Companies That Put Purpose Before Profit
  • Competitive compensation including equity
  • A spacious office near Chancery Lane, where you can enjoy weekly team lunches
  • Comprehensive health scheme offered through AXA
  • Partnership with YellowNest, a salary exchange benefit that helps reduce childcare fees for working parents

title: Associate General Manager
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As an Associate General Manager on Via’s Operations team, you’ll be responsible for managing operations using our innovative technology platform. You’ll manage a team of local field operators focused on daily operations, driving continuous operational and quality improvements, and growing our services.

This is a fully in-person position with the expectation that you will be onsite 4-5 days per week. There may be a need for early mornings or evenings.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage the daily onsite operations of our service. You’ll make sure our operations run smoothly to provide our riders with safe, reliable, and accessible transportation.
  • Make informed, real-time decisions about fleet, driver supply, compliance, rider needs, and unexpected issues - stepping in quickly to ensure continuously excellent and dependable service.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle for drivers — scheduling, PTO approvals, daily inquiries, performance conversations, and adherence to workplace policies.
  • Manage driver work schedules to ensure the appropriate amount of vehicles are in service at any given time to meet demand expectations.
  • Act as the operational bridge between city partners, drivers, unions, community leaders, local organizations to help bring the community's goals to life.
  • Use data and technology to understand service performance, diagnose problems, and implement solutions that enhance efficiency and rider experience.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant federal, state, local and company policies, procedures and regulations on service operations.
  • Lead, coach and develop an engaged team of drivers, fostering a collaborative, cohesive, and energetic environment.

  • Experienced operations manager, with a minimum of 4-6 years of experience and hold a Bachelor's degree.
  • Independent self-starter, you thrive in fast-paced environments and feel comfortable with a very high level of responsibility.
  • Savvy and tactful communicator: you intuitively find the right tone in every situation.
  • Detail-oriented executor: you’re obsessively action-oriented, and thrive while operating autonomously.
  • Experienced and exceptional leader: people love working with you and for you, and you have extensive experience leading support teams.
  • Flexible and adaptable: you love the challenge of adapting to change rapidly and making things work on the fly.
  • Problem solver; you don’t accept the status quo and are always looking for creative solutions.
  • Based in the Baton Rouge, LA area or willing to relocate.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
  • Salary Range: $80,000 - $125,000 / year.
  • We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

title: Business Coordinator, Tokyo (Part-time/Partially remote)
description:
Via is rapidly growing globally and in the Japan market. We are seeking a highly proactive and detail-oriented Business Coordinator to support our invoicing, payment, contracting, and general business operations. This is a part-time role for someone who responds quickly, communicates clearly, and can execute tasks independently with minimal hand-holding.

The ideal candidate is resourceful, adaptable, and comfortable handling a wide range of tasks beyond a rigid job description. We value ownership, speed, and problem-solving ability.

  • Prepare and process invoices, PO requests, payment documentation, and related paperwork.
  • Coordinate contracting procedures, including collecting vendor information, preparing agreements, arranging signatures, and maintaining contract logs.
  • Maintain internal trackers and filing systems.
  • Communicate efficiently with both internal teams and external partners.
  • Support business operations, scheduling, and general administrative workflows.
  • Proactively identify next steps, gather missing information, and move tasks forward without needing detailed instructions.
  • Handle ad-hoc administrative and coordination tasks as needed.

  • Agility and willingness to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.

  • Fast and reliable communication style.
  • Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and complete tasks with limited supervision.
  • Strong administrative skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Tech-savvy: comfortable with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and digital workflows.

Ideal Candidate Traits

  • Strong “get things done” mindset.
  • Proactive and resourceful problem-solver.
  • Flexible and willing to take on a wide variety of tasks.
  • Comfortable working in dynamic, sometimes ambiguous environments.
  • Able to operate independently and take initiative without needing detailed step-by-step direction

title: CDL Driver

As a CDL Driver at SAM by Via, you will drive buses and provide outstanding customer service to riders in the immediate Sioux Falls area.

What You’ll Do:

  • Safely and courteously, operate lift-equipped vehicles to transport elderly and/or disabled persons
  • Learn the fundamentals of SAM by Via operations and related safety procedures
  • Perform the routine operation of agency vehicles

Who You Are:

title: Director, Product — Remix Multimodal Transit
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

About the role:

Remix is Via's premier transit planning and scheduling platform, trusted by transit agencies worldwide to design networks, model scenarios, and optimize service. We're looking for a Director of Product to define and drive the next era of Remix: a multimodal planning and scheduling system that gives transit agencies a single, authoritative place to make smarter decisions across every service type they operate.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role. You will shape the vision for how agencies move from static schedules to data-driven, dynamically optimized operations — balancing labor union rules and contractual constraints with the operational agility modern transit demands. You will own the end-to-end product experience from strategic planning through live execution, and your work will directly affect how millions of riders experience public transit every day.

What you will do:

  • Define and own the product vision and roadmap for Remix as the global standard for multimodal transit planning and scheduling, spanning fixed route, paratransit, microtransit, and emerging modes
  • Build the framework for data-driven scheduling — enabling agencies to make optimal use of driver and vehicle time through intelligent analysis of ridership patterns, operational constraints, and service goals
  • Deeply understand and incorporate labor union rules, collective bargaining agreements, and workforce regulations into the product in a way that is structured yet flexible enough to adapt as those rules evolve
  • Connect planning and scheduling seamlessly to live operations, reducing the gap between what is scheduled and what is executed — improving accuracy, dispatcher confidence, and rider reliability
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and GTM teams to move from vision to shipped product with clear milestones and measurable outcomes
  • Engage directly and frequently with transit planners, schedulers, and operations leaders to surface unmet needs and validate product direction
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging regulations, and competitive dynamics to keep Remix ahead of the market

Who You Are:

  • You have 10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex enterprise software products
  • Have a track record of shipping high-quality products for sophisticated, workflow-heavy enterprise environments where the cost of getting it wrong is high
  • Are a systems thinker who can hold both strategic vision and operational detail — you know when to zoom out and when to get into the weeds
  • Have strong instincts for simplifying complexity: translating divergent customer needs and intricate business rules into clean, scalable product decisions
  • Bring deep empathy for the professionals who use your product daily — planners, schedulers, dispatchers — and design with their real working context in mind
  • Can quickly become technically fluent in the underlying data models and entities that power scheduling and operations systems — blocks, runs, trips, stops, vehicles, duties, pairings — and can engage at that level of specificity with engineers and architects
  • Are a strong, credible voice in technical architecture decisions alongside your engineering partners, capable of evaluating tradeoffs and advocating for platform choices that serve both current product needs and long-term scalability
  • Experience with resource management, labor scheduling, or workforce optimization software is a strong plus
  • Experience in transportation, transit, or logistics is a plus but not required — intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn technical domains quickly matter more

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range: $200,000-$250,000, determined by experience and skills. Total compensation also includes variable pay and equity.
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.
  • A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting.
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.
  • Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Central US
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Via, you’ll lead sales for your region across both public and private sectors, helping cities move toward more inclusive, sustainable, tech-enabled transportation. You’ll own a revenue target and run your market end-to-end: finding opportunities, building the right relationships, and turning big mobility ideas into real, closed deals. As part of Via’s Partnerships team, you’ll go far beyond traditional sales. We work side-by-side with cities and private operators to define what great mobility looks like and turn it into real, deployed systems: moving fast, taking ownership, and holding ourselves to a high bar for impact.

This is a remote-first role based in the US Central region. We're ideally looking for candidates in Chicago or the broader Midwest, but are open to other locations including Texas.

What You'll Do

  • Identify prospective partners in your territory and build meaningful and durable revenue-generating relationships with a diverse group of prospective clients, from elected officials to private-sector business leaders. Lead execution and strategy for full-cycle Sales efforts across your territory, working to make transit better for your community, and your region’s communities.
  • Strategically navigate your market’s unique buying landscape using research strong analytical skills to build compelling, data-driven business cases for our platform and demonstrate our value proposition across a range of verticals..
  • Be a thought partner to prospective clients by educating and consulting with them to develop regional transit plans and find funding mechanisms within your market.
  • Champion our mission and technology as the “face of Via” by leading local marketing campaigns, speaking at conferences, and providing consistent thought leadership in the mobility space.

Who You Are

  • You have a minimum of 4+ years of client facing experience with a record of achievement in the Sales, Business Development, Consulting, or similar space
  • An educator, collaborator, and thought partner: you enjoy consultative sales processes, and know how to use data to build a compelling narrative
  • A skilled and methodical researcher: you’re attracted to complex problems, and you’re not afraid to jump into new environments.
  • Intuitive communicator; whether in customer conversations, product presentations, or written proposals, you always strike the right tone and communicate persuasively.
  • Superb commercial intuition and exceptional judgment -- you know when to push and when to yield in maximizing the value of a potential deal.
  • A reliable, motivated self-starter with a passionate growth mentality. You enjoy fast-paced environments, aren’t deterred by setbacks or pivots, and thrive in roles requiring a very high degree of responsibility.
  • An excellent team player; you’re a meaningful individual contributor, and a mentor to others on your team. You view successes as team efforts, and enjoy working with others.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary range: $85,000-$110,000, determined by experience and skills. Total compensation also includes variable pay and equity.
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.
  • A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting.
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.
  • Additional benefits (family planning, mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Via, you'll be a founding member of Via's new AI Labs - an incubator-style team operating like a startup within the company. This is a rare opportunity to get in at the ground floor of something genuinely new: a dedicated space to move fast, experiment boldly, and build AI-powered products that could fundamentally change how Via and our partner cities operate. You'll have real autonomy, direct access to leadership, and the backing of a company that's already at scale - without the constraints that usually come with it. If you're experienced at building AI products end-to-end and you're energized by the idea of doing that with a blank canvas, this is the role for you.

About the Role:

  • Build and ship production-grade AI products end-to-end - owning everything from problem framing and data pipeline design through to deployment and iteration in live environments.
  • Work closely with our customers in a forward-deployed manner to deeply understand problems and constraints and iterate quickly on scalable agentic solutions.
  • Lead technical scoping workshops, directly interfacing with city leaders to solve challenging local problems with agentic workflows.
  • Work across a fast-moving and varied roadmap, contributing to intelligent tooling involving data consolidation, predictive modelling, real-time decision-making, and LLM-powered experiences.
  • Collaborate directly with product, data science, and operations teams to identify and prioritize the highest-impact AI opportunities across the business.
  • Write clean, scalable backend and frontend code that powers AI-driven features - designing APIs, managing data flows, and ensuring your systems perform reliably at scale.
  • Help shape the technical culture of AI Labs from the ground up - contributing to how the team builds, reviews, ships, and iterates.
  • Stay close to the frontier of AI development and bring new ideas, tools, and approaches into the team proactively.

About You:

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on experience building full stack applications - with a track record of owning features end-to-end rather than working in isolation on models or research.
  • You have 3+ years of working with AI tools and/or building AI powered products
  • You have deep expertise across the AI stack - including LLMs, predictive modelling, and the data infrastructure required to support them in real-world environments.
  • You're a strong backend engineer at your core - comfortable designing scalable APIs, working with distributed systems, and writing code that is clean, maintainable, and built to last.
  • You're energized by ambiguity and early-stage environments - you don't need everything to be defined to do great work, and you take ownership without being asked.
  • You bring the communication skills to work cross-functionally and the intellectual curiosity to keep pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI.
  • You thrive when working directly with users and customers, and are comfortable with travel to collaborate on-site.

The decisions you make here will shape how the market runs for years.

These are complex portfolios, generally with larger partner organizations, and strong strategic scope. You'll arrive with the credibility and operational fluency to lead at that level from day one.

    • Own and manage the end-to-end operating strategy of Via’s service on behalf of our partner
    • Define and manage against KPIs spanning on-time performance, rider satisfaction, safety, and cost efficiency
    • Translate weekly and monthly performance data into decisions

    • Lead a 30+ team of field operators and drivers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and culture setting
    • Build an operation where people feel accountable, supported, and proud of what they're delivering
    • Develop frontline leaders within your team who can grow into expanded roles

    • Represent Via to community stakeholders, local officials, and riders

    • Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements that strengthen margin without compromising service
  • Product Development
    • Influence the product roadmap for Via's newest Fixed Route products

Who You Are:

  • Leadership instinct and experience: You know how to motivate and inspire individuals, from drivers all the way to a transit agency’s CEO
  • Ownership mentality: You can build systems that prevent things from going wrong and, if they still do, you find what’s going wrong, own it, and fix it

title: Global Head of Payroll
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As Global Head of Payroll, you will lead and scale payroll operations across our global footprint, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery for employees across the United States, Europe, Israel, and other international markets supported through employer-of-record (EOR) and payroll partners. This role is responsible for global payroll strategy, payroll operations, compliance, vendor management, and payroll technology.

You will build and develop a high-performing global payroll organization, establish scalable processes and controls, and serve as a key partner to the Finance, Legal, People, and Operations teams. Success in this role requires a hands-on leader who can operate strategically while remaining close to the details, driving operational excellence in a fast-paced, high-growth, and globally distributed environment.

What You'll Do

  • Lead global payroll operations across all countries and entities, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant payroll processing.
  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of Payroll Managers and payroll professionals across multiple regions.
  • Establish scalable payroll governance, controls, policies, and operating procedures that support a growing global workforce.
  • Own relationships with global payroll providers, Employer of Record partners, tax advisors, and other payroll vendors, ensuring service quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with People Operations to ensure the accurate and timely flow of employee data, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, benefits, leave programs, equity transactions, and organizational changes.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Equity Administration, and Legal to ensure compliance with global payroll regulations and reporting requirements.
  • Ensure accurate processing and reporting of equity compensation, including RSUs, stock options, and related payroll tax obligations.
  • Drive payroll technology strategy and optimization, including Workday Payroll, global payroll platforms like P&I Loga and iiPay, integrations, automation, reporting, and system implementations.
  • Develop meaningful payroll metrics, dashboards, and reporting packages, including headcount reporting, payroll spend analysis, variance analysis, payroll tax reporting, and executive-level reporting.
  • Ensure accurate and timely payroll tax filings, registrations, remittances, garnishments, and statutory reporting requirements globally.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve controls, reduce risk, and enhance the employee payroll experience.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex payroll matters and drive timely resolution of payroll-related issues.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive payroll leadership experience, including responsibility for multinational payroll operations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading global payroll teams across multiple countries and regions.
  • Strong understanding of payroll taxes, financial controls, and payroll compliance.
  • Proven ability to build scalable payroll processes and lead through periods of growth, change, and system transformation.
  • Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Hands-on leadership style with a willingness to dive into operational details when needed.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
  • High degree of discretion and commitment to maintaining confidentiality.

  • Experience building and mentoring high-performing payroll teams.

title: Head of Risk & Insurance
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person's daily commute to reducing humanity's collective environmental footprint — we've got huge goals.

As Head of Risk & Insurance, you will lead Via's insurance program, shaping its strategy, structure, and operations, as well as continuing to expand it as we take on new business lines. Reporting to the COO, you'll be close to the integral parts of the business where risk shows up first.

What You'll Do:

  • Own Via's insurance program end-to-end: assess our risk profile, identify the coverage we need, and put risk programs in place across the markets we operate in
  • Partner with senior leadership on risk strategy, including coverage decisions, alternative risk transfer (captives, self-insured retentions), and how risk and insurance figure into Via's broader operational and financial planning
  • Manage brokerage and carrier relationships: run renewals, evaluate quotes, negotiate terms, and select partners who can grow with us globally
  • Build the systems and team to manage claims and litigation efficiently: define how incidents are reported; how reserves are set; and how we run a highly effective claims management process
  • Develop a risk management strategy that goes beyond insurance: partner with Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to identify and reduce loss exposure
  • Build the internal infrastructure: put policies, processes, dashboards, and reporting in place so the rest of the company has clear visibility into our risks
  • Stand up the analytics that tell us whether the program is working: monitor loss ratios, claim frequency and severity, cost per mile, and retention thresholds and use them to inform every renewal
  • Lead, grow and develop Via’s risk team as the program scales

Who You Are:

  • You have built and run an insurance program before — ideally one with significant operational exposure, and ideally at a company operating across multiple jurisdictions. You know what excellent looks like because you've built it.
  • You have at least 10+ years of experience in risk management, insurance, or a closely adjacent function
  • At the same time, you’re excited to build. You thrive in ambiguity and are excited to help scale a function at a rapidly growing company
  • You think commercially. Insurance is both a cost to be optimized and a risk management tool to be wielded. You understand both sides and can make trade-offs that hold up to scrutiny
  • You are analytical and data-driven. You leverage claims, litigation, and operational insights to identify trends, evaluate risk, and drive decisions that improve outcomes and reduce costs
  • You are operationally minded. You know how to translate strategy into process, headcount, and tooling and how to do it in a way that scales
  • You are hands-on and low ego — no task is too small if it helps contributes to Via’s success

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Final salary will be determined by the candidate's experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.

title: Launch Operations Principal
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As a Launch Operations Principal, you will sit at the intersection of operational strategy and execution, launching a growing pipeline of new, complex services across markets. For each launch, you will serve as the leader of a transit network transformation; taking full ownership of the technology and operational transition, service performance, partner relationships, and a 30+ frontline team. You will be setting up Via's newest services in high-visibility markets that require building new operational systems from the ground up, not just managing existing ones. The decisions you make here will shape how the market runs for years.

This is a unique leadership and operating opportunity for anyone who is eager to lead and launch high-stakes, high-visibility, and high-impact new markets at Via. The role is excellent for a generalist looking for exposure in strategy, operations and product/technology.

This role requires a willingness to travel up to 50% of the time.

About the Role:

  • Launch & Service Performance
    • Own and manage launch of new Via services, from technology implementation to operational setup
    • Define and manage against KPIs spanning on-time performance, rider satisfaction, safety, and cost efficiency
    • Translate weekly and monthly performance data into decisions
  • People Leadership
    • Lead a 30+ team of field operators and drivers during the launch transition, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and culture setting
    • Build an operation where people feel accountable, supported, and proud of what they're delivering
    • Hire, develop and train frontline leaders who will run the long-term operations
  • Partner & Stakeholder Management
    • Own Via's relationship with the transit agency partner, a public entity with its own board, elected officials, and community accountability
    • Represent Via to community stakeholders, local officials, and riders
  • Operational Excellence
    • Drive continuous improvement across vehicle operations, maintenance protocols, and service delivery
    • Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements that strengthen margin without compromising service
  • Product Development
    • Influence the product roadmap for Via's newest product lines

About You:

  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in operations, consulting, strategy, tech or a field with meaningful client accountability and a demonstrated ability to lead big projects and develop teams
  • Ownership mentality: You get things done. You plan ahead, manage risks and design processes that prevent things from going wrong and, if they still do, you find what’s going wrong, own it, and fix it
  • Leadership instinct and experience: You know how to motivate and inspire individuals, from drivers all the way to a transit agency’s CEO
  • Effective at managing multiple tasks simultaneously: You can delegate, prioritize, and take responsibility.
  • Attention to detail and operational judgment: No detail is too small, and nothing gets passed you. You're equally comfortable in a spreadsheet as in the field
  • Partner and stakeholder sophistication: You know how to manage relationships that are complex, high-stakes, and not fully in your control
  • Mission alignment that goes beyond the talking points: You embrace that Via's partners are public agencies serving communities that often don't have other options
  • Flexible and adaptable: You love the challenge of adapting to change rapidly and making things work on the fly

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
  • Salary Range: $120,000-$160,000
  • We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans, 401K matching, catered lunch on Wednesdays, and many other perks.

title: Mobile Engineering Manager
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As a Mobile Engineering Manager at Via, you’ll lead the development of product areas within our mobile apps that helps transit agencies deliver reliable and efficient service to their communities. You’ll guide a team of engineers in building something entirely new while working closely with other teams to ensure the product integrates seamlessly into Via’s ecosystem. This role offers the unique opportunity to create from the ground up while leveraging the strengths of an established platform to maximize impact.

About the Role:

  • Lead the development of key mobile initiatives, such as improving rider/driver app performance, reliability, and user experience across iOS and Android
  • Own and execute a roadmap focused on scalability (e.g. handling peak demand, optimizing app responsiveness, and reducing latency across core user flows)
  • Drive cross-functional projects with Product, Design, and Backend teams to launch new features end-to-end, from concept through production
  • Improve engineering quality and velocity by introducing better development practices, strengthening code review standards, and evolving mobile architecture
  • Build and grow a high-performing team by hiring, mentoring, and supporting engineers across different levels
  • Identify and lead improvements to team processes (e.g. release cycles, CI/CD, testing frameworks) to increase efficiency and reduce friction
  • Contribute to broader mobile initiatives, such as aligning on shared tooling, frameworks, and long-term platform strategy

About You:

  • 7+ years of experience building mobile applications (iOS or Android), including experience working on production-scale apps
  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex projects end-to-end
  • Strong understanding of mobile architecture, performance optimization, and modern development practices (e.g. CI/CD, testing, MVVM)
  • Comfortable working across mobile, backend, and product domains to deliver cohesive solutions
  • Collaborative and pragmatic, able to balance speed with quality and make thoughtful trade-offs
  • Hands-on and detail-oriented when needed, while still operating effectively at a leadership level
  • Clear communicator who builds trust across teams and creates a positive, inclusive team environment

Compensation and Benefits

  • Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
  • Salary Range: $200,000 - $250,000
  • We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

We’re Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.

Our teams of worldclass engineers, data-scientists, product managers, operations specialists, marketers, transit experts and more bring cutting-edge AI-powered software and innovative technology-enabled operations to our partners across the globe. Founded in 2012, Via builds solutions to digitize, automate, and enable data-driven decision making for entire transportation networks; fixed-route buses, microtransit, paratransit, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and more.

If you’re excited to be at the forefront of modernizing the future of transportation, are up for solving tough problems, and willing to become/already are a transit nerd, we are the place for you. title: Motion & AI Video Designer (Via, Remix, Citymapper)
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As a Motion & AI Video Designer (Via, Remix, Citymapper), you’ll bring our brands and products to life through bold videos and motion graphics moving people’s hearts and minds. This role is based in New York City and reports directly to the Creative Director of our in-house studio. The studio is responsible for elevating Via, Citymapper and Remix brands, and delivering communications to our riders, commercial partners and investors across all channels. We care about the quality of your output and your ability to create with AI-native workflows, regardless of your years of formal experience. Candidates of all levels are welcome to apply. Join us to design the future of transportation and take the brand to the next level.

What You'll Do:

  • Turn information into stories: Lead high-stakes projects, transforming complex information into clear, impactful motion narratives that drive outcomes for B2G or B2C audiences.
  • Create Via’s first Motion Design System: Document and build a comprehensive library of motion patterns and kinetic behaviors that scale across our marketing and product touchpoints.
  • Establish AI-native workflows: Use AI to elevate our creativity, scale our output and reduce production cycles.
  • Bring interactive products to life: Bridge the gap between marketing and product by designing delightful micro-interactions and UX motion. Implement animations natively using tools like Lottie or Rive.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with stakeholders (marketing, business, product) to manage and execute projects internally, or with video production partners.
  • Mentorship and development: Support creative peers so they develop their understanding of motion and AI craft to elevate the entire design organization.

Who You Are:

  • A world-class motion and video designer with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional talent, regardless of your years of formal experience. You understand foundational animation principles (timing, physics, easing, weight).
  • An expert in translating complex technical concepts (i.e., data science visualizations, technical product infrastructure flows, process optimization algorithms) into intuitive and impactful motion graphics.
  • A big-picture thinker who can seamlessly move between high-level conceptualization and pixel-perfect execution, under tight deadlines.
  • An expert at generative AI motion and keep refining your Claude / Gemini set-up.
  • You know which model to pick to get the best out of a project (Nano Banana, Runway, Kling, Seedance).
  • You have experimented with node-based generative workflow (ComfyUI, Krea.ai, Weave) and understand the best creative workflow for a given project.
  • Proficient with After Effects and the Creative Suite, and interaction design tools like Rive.
  • Understanding of 3d softwares like Cinema 4D/Blender is welcome.

What Catches Our Eye:

  • A great reel: We care about the quality of the output, not the number of years on your resume.
  • Great stories: Move hearts & minds.
  • AI workflows: We look for examples or case studies showing how you've integrated AI tools into a professional pipeline to drastically reduce production time while increasing visual impact.
  • Systems over standalones: Evidence of having built and documented comprehensive Motion Design Systems.
  • Motion into Interaction design: Real-world examples of your motion work living natively inside a digital product or app.
  • An obsession with the details: An uncompromising eye for the invisible elements of motion: perfect easing curves, realistic physics, rhythmic timing, and weight.

title: Partnership Proposals Lead
description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As a Partnership Proposals Lead at Via, you'll craft persuasive, exceptionally-written proposals that forge new partnerships with cities, transit agencies, and other public transit providers. Working with members of Via’s Strategy and executive leadership teams, you will develop a deep understanding of our customers' needs and goals, become an expert in Via’s unique positioning as a technology partner, and own high-quality written proposals for transformative mobility services. Partnership Proposals Leads gain wide-ranging experience in Via's products and services; no specific experience in technology or public transit services is required.

What You'll Do:

  • Hone your strategic thinking skills by coordinating with Via’s Partnerships, Expansion, and Finance teams to develop strategies for winning high-stakes, competitive procurements.
  • Become an expert in Via’s technology and product offerings, absorbing complex, sometimes technical specifications and distilling information into clear, easily-digestible prose for both internal and external audiences.
  • Write, review, and copy-edit comprehensive long-form narrative proposals for potential partners.
  • Generate compelling original content by ascertaining an audience’s needs and deploying your familiarity with Via’s technology and operational capabilities, transit norms, and the latest innovations from across the industry.
  • Lead competitive procurements from beginning to end -- through evaluation, creation of exceptional proposal content, review, and submission.
  • Conduct rigorous research by analyzing news stories, new service announcements, scopes of work, city histories, and other forms of information and synthesizing findings into insightful commentary.
  • Skillfully manage communications with potential partners over the phone and email.
  • Support senior team members during interviews and launches with cities and transit agencies.

Who You Are:

  • You’re meticulous and thoughtful. You can pay attention to every detail in a complex project while, at the same time, relating each of them to the big picture in a coherent way. You can see the forest and the trees.
  • You have a minimum of 4 years of experience with a record of achievement in roles that require extensive and impeccable written communication. This could take many forms: graduate theses and dissertations, business proposals, policy memos, creative non-fiction, or journalism, to name a few. If you've won awards for your writing, that's a plus!
  • You’re passionate about having an impact and are excited about advancing Via's mission to build more efficient, sustainable, and equitable transit systems. You’re excited about urban studies, environmental studies, accessibility, equity, and public governance.
  • You have exceptional judgment and strategic intuition. You know when to push and when to compromise when crafting a persuasive narrative.
  • You’re a collaborative, on-task project manager. You keep things moving through strong, clear communication and can manage multiple stakeholders across a single project.
  • You're a reliable, motivated self-starter. You enjoy fast-paced environments, aren’t deterred by setbacks or pivots, and thrive in roles requiring a very high degree of responsibility.
  • You’re data-savvy and believe in evidence-based arguments. You excel at crafting compelling narratives using a wide range of quantitative and qualitative metrics.
  • You’re an academic high-achiever, preferably in the humanities or social sciences where you practiced qualitative analysis and long-form writing (undergraduate degree required; advanced degree preferred).

What We Offer:

  • All final pay rates will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data
  • Salary Range: $115,000-$160,000
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans
  • A 401(k) with company match and vesting
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options
  • Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)

We’re Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.

Our teams of world-class engineers, data-scientists, product managers, operations specialists, marketers, transit experts and more bring cutting-edge AI-powered software and innovative technology-enabled operations to our partners across the globe. Founded in 2012, Via builds solutions to digitize, automate, and enable data-driven decision making for entire transportation networks; fixed-route buses, microtransit, paratransit, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and more.

If you’re excited to be at the forefront of modernizing the future of transportation, are up for solving tough problems, and willing to become/already are a transit nerd, we are the place for you. Even if your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

Ready to join the ride?

title: Payroll Lead, EMEA
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As Payroll Lead EMEA, you'll own the end-to-end payroll process for over 1,400 employees across the region - keeping one of the most critical parts of our business running smoothly, accurately, and compliantly. You'll actively process payroll for our German hourly workforce, while also providing guidance and oversight to our Payroll Managers responsible for Israel and the rest of Europe (employees across Israel, UK, Germany, France, and the Netherlands). As we continue to scale across Europe, you'll work closely with our Finance, People, and Operations teams to strengthen payroll processes and ensure our teams are paid reliably and on time, every month.

We are also open to remote candidates as long as you have the flexibility to travel up to once a month to either Berlin or Amsterdam to participate in payroll processing with local teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive the monthly payroll process for Via Germany - partnering closely with our external payroll provider and internal Finance, People, and Operations teams to ensure accurate, timely execution every month.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to our Payroll Managers across Israel and the rest of Europe (UK, Germany, France, and the Netherlands), ensuring consistent standards and best practices across the region.
  • Monitor changes in German tax regulations, wage laws, and compliance requirements, making sure our processes stay aligned with evolving regulatory standards.
  • Perform regular payroll audits to maintain the accuracy and integrity of employee pay data, and proactively design and implement process improvements and internal controls.
  • Manage benefit deductions and tax withholdings, ensuring calculations and reporting are precise, compliant, and handled with the highest confidentiality.
  • Lead payroll-related financial reporting - from preparing journal entries to reconciling general ledger accounts.
  • Support on escalated payroll queries that the Support Operations team can't resolve independently.
  • Contribute to cross-functional projects and operational improvements that strengthen payroll processes and support the broader Finance team.

Who You Are

  • You bring 7+ years of dedicated German payroll experience, including for hourly/shift-based employees, with a strong grasp of local regulations and tax requirements - in this role, German payroll will make up the majority of your day-to-day work.
  • You are familiar with payroll in other EMEA countries, e.g. Israel, UK, France, Netherlands.
  • You're comfortable working with HRIS and payroll systems such as P&I Loga, and highly proficient in Microsoft Excel.
  • You work with precision and ownership - detail-oriented, reliable, and able to meet strict deadlines independently.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across Finance, People, and other internal teams.
  • You're proactive and process-driven, always looking for ways to improve workflows and make things run more smoothly.
  • Prior experience leading or guiding a team is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Becoming part of a company that was awarded for its commitment to social good.
  • Salary range: between €70,000-€120,000 per year, plus equity. Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • If you're based in Berlin: a lovely office in the heart of the city at Chausseestraße, weekly team lunches and breakfast - and a team you'll love working with.
  • Urban Sports Club membership.
  • Company pension scheme (bAV) with a 20% employer contribution.
  • 30 vacation days a year.

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a designer who thrives on complexity. You’ll take on some of the most challenging areas of our operations platform: deeply interconnected workflows, information-dense systems, and products used for hours every day by dispatchers and transit operators to make decisions that directly impact riders and drivers.

As a Principal Product Designer, you’ll bring exceptional product judgment, systems thinking, and craft. You’ll turn ambiguity into clear product direction and carry that direction through execution in close partnership with Product, Engineering, and leadership. Your influence will extend beyond the work you directly own - helping establish patterns, challenge assumptions, and raise the quality and coherence of the broader Transit Operations experience and Design organization.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead design for complex and strategic areas of Via’s Transit Operations product, setting direction across interconnected workflows and creating coherent, scalable experiences.
  • Transform complex operational workflows, business requirements, and technical constraints into experiences that are clear, intuitive, and purposeful. Move fluidly between systems-level thinking and detailed execution - personally carrying ideas from early exploration through polished, production-ready experiences.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to frame problems, explore possibilities, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive high-quality product decisions.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the users and communities we serve, and design experiences that are tightly aligned with their needs.
  • Use research, data, experimentation, and customer feedback to validate decisions and continuously improve the product.
  • Proactively identify opportunities, bring clarity to ambiguous problem spaces, and create momentum where direction is unclear.
  • Raise the quality bar for Transit Operations and influence the broader Design organization through the strength of your work, critique, collaboration, and contribution to shared patterns and systems.
  • Help shape the future of product design at Via by exploring new ways of thinking, creating, and validating products - including leveraging AI as part of your everyday workflow.

What we’re looking for:

  • Extensive experience designing and shipping complex digital products and platforms, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional product thinking, craft, and the ability to create scalable solutions for sophisticated operational systems.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and lead complex product initiatives end-to-end, using strong product judgment to create simple, clear, and impactful experiences.

  • A strong collaborator who builds alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, and leadership, using clear communication, thoughtful critique, and influence to drive better product decisions.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Citymapper
description:
At Citymapper (a Via company), we’re on a mission to help make complex cities more accessible to everyday users. Our application transports millions of people in hundreds of cities around the world by giving them access to the most current and sophisticated transportation options available. We make getting around your favourite city easy, so that you can enjoy the ride.

As Strategy & Operations Manager at Citymapper, you will lead a talented team of Analysts who play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of Citymapper's data. This is a hands-on, leadership-first role: you'll coach and develop your team, remove blockers, and create the conditions for them to succeed. Sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and commercial teams, you will help set priorities, solve complex problems, and ensure the team's work drives meaningful improvements for Citymapper and its users.

About the Role

  • Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of Data Analysts, creating an environment where people can do their best work.
  • Own the data strategy and quality for your region across Citymapper’s web and mobile products, ensuring millions of users can rely on us every day.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities and deliver high-impact improvements across the platform.
  • Shape the evolution of the team's tools, workflows, and automation, partnering with engineers to build systems that scale with the business.
  • Turn complex datasets into actionable insights that guide decisions and drive improvements across the product.

Who You Are

  • An experienced people leader: you have experience directly managing and developing a team, with a track record of coaching others, giving thoughtful feedback, and creating an environment where people can grow and succeed.
  • A strong operator: you bring 4+ years of experience in an operational, technical, product, or cross-functional role, and you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and finding a way forward when the path isn't obvious.
  • Technically comfortable: you can engage with data and product work, understand complex problems, and build trust with technical teams without needing to be the most technical person in the room.
  • A strong project manager: you bring structure to complex work, keep multiple priorities moving, and balance attention to detail with the bigger picture.
  • A clear communicator: you build trust quickly across functions and are equally comfortable in an engineering discussion, a product conversation, or a business planning session.

Nice to Have

  • Bonus points if you have experience working with data, Python, and/or common transit data formats (GTFS, TransXChange, SIRI, HAFAS, etc.), but it's not a requirement. What matters most to us is your curiosity: the willingness to dive into new topics, figure things out, and keep learning.

What We Offer

  • Salary Range: $100,000-$115,000. Total compensation also includes equity. Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.
  • A 401(k) with company match and vesting.
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.
  • Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.
  • Hybrid work from our New York office, with weekly team lunches.

title: Werkstudent:in, Recht
description:
Via nutzt innovative Technologien, um den Transport weltweit zu revolutionieren. Von der Veränderung des täglichen Pendelns einer einzelnen Person bis zur Reduzierung des kollektiven ökologischen Fußabdrucks der Menschheit – wir haben große Ziele.

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Recht wirst du ein wichtiger Teil unseres dynamischen, globalen Rechtsteams und arbeitest eng mit einem Team hoch engagierter Anwält:innen in Europa, Israel und New York zusammen. Dabei hilfst du uns, unser Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen und neue Projekte auf den Weg zu bringen. Mit Unterstützung eines Mentors lernst du die vielschichtigen Aufgaben eines Syndikusanwalts kennen und erhältst gleichzeitig einzigartige Einblicke in die Rechtsabteilung eines schnell wachsenden Scale-ups.

Dies ist eine Station im Rahmen des Rechtsreferendariats mit einer Mindestdauer von 6 Monaten, idealerweise mit Start im September 2026. Die Stelle ist in Berlin angesiedelt, im hybriden Arbeitsmodell.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Unterstützung bei geschäftskritischen Vertragsangelegenheiten:
    • Prüfung und Koordination des Vertragsabschlusses (z. B. NDAs, SaaS-Verträge, Lieferantenverträge, Mietverträge), unter Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit und Identifizierung zentraler Risiken
    • Unterstützung bei der Pflege und Organisation von Vertragsdatenbanken und -vorlagen
  • Unterstützung beim Management wichtiger regulatorischer und Compliance-Themen:
    • Durchführung rechtlicher und regulatorischer Recherchen in für Via relevanten Bereichen, u. a. Transportnetzwerkdienste, Gig Economy, Versicherungen, Open-Source-Daten und Datenschutzrecht
    • Überwachung der Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze durch die Kontrolle von Auftragsverarbeitungsverträgen (DPAs) mit Lieferanten und Partnern
    • Unterstützung der internen Compliance und Corporate Governance von Via
  • Vorantreiben von Effizienz- und Prozessverbesserungen:
    • Aufbau von Kenntnissen interner Datenbanken und Systeme, um aus Daten Erkenntnisse für Geschäftsentscheidungen zu gewinnen
    • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung des Rechtsteams durch Ticketing-Systeme, Dokumentenmanagement- und Ablagesysteme sowie KPI-Tracking
    • Führende Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Pflege und Verbesserung von Formularen, Prozessen und Systemen
    • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung rechtlicher Prozesse zur Steigerung von Skalierbarkeit und Effizienz
    • Administrative Unterstützung sowie Mitarbeit an Sonderprojekten nach Bedarf

Dein Profil:

  • Du befindest dich aktuell im Rechtsreferendariat und bist berechtigt, eine Station bei einer internen Rechtsabteilung zu absolvieren
  • Erste Erfahrung mit oder Interesse an Tech-, Datenschutz- oder Regulierungsrecht; Kenntnisse der DSGVO von Vorteil
  • Sicherer Umgang mit internen Systemen und Daten - du kannst aus Datenbanken Erkenntnisse für Geschäftsentscheidungen ableiten
  • Klare und präzise Kommunikation, schriftlich wie mündlich, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Konzepte für fachfremde Stakeholder verständlich zu machen
  • Organisiert und detailorientiert, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Arbeitsstränge gleichzeitig zu managen
  • Proaktiv und lernbereit - du übernimmst Eigeninitiative und schöpfst Energie aus der Vielseitigkeit einer internen Rechtsrolle in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Fließend in Englisch und Deutsch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse von Vorteil

Was wir bieten:

  • Eine Rolle mit echtem Impact: Via's Technologie bewegt täglich Millionen von Menschen weltweit - und du sorgst dafür, dass das Team dahinter reibungslos funktioniert.
  • Gehalt: 20 € pro Stunde
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in einem schönen Büro im Herzen Berlins an der Chausseestraße, wöchentliche Team-Lunches und gemeinsames Frühstück -und ein Team, das du kennenlernen solltest
  • Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Bei Via entwickeln wir Technologien, die die Mobilität auf der ganzen Welt zum Besseren verändern. Unser Fokus liegt auf dem Bereich Transit-Tech, denn wir sind überzeugt, dass die Zukunft des Transports in der geteilten, dynamischen und öffentlichen Mobilität liegt. Unser Ansatz reduziert Kohlenstoffemissionen in überlasteten Städten, verringert die Abhängigkeit von privaten Autos und ermöglicht allen Menschen den Zugang zu effizienten und erschwinglichen Möglichkeiten der Fortbewegung.

Bereit für die Fahrt?

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität
